user_reported_bug: Could we add a missing data and data quality check report with a fix option
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused verification showed the Data Quality page/report exists and most auto-fix flows work, but the fix is not fully correct: session.too_long_16h does not cap all >16h attendance rows, and config.empty_categories falsely fires while the app has category rows in db.categories.

critical.issue: Endpoint returned {fixed:1} for the synthetic row but left 3 pre-existing attendance rows with check_out_at - check_in_at > 16h. This violates the contract that all >16h rows are capped and likely comes from silently catching parse/subtraction errors on mixed datetime formats.

config.empty_categories is reported even though db.categories contains 5 category master rows. Detector reads db.categories_master, but the app's actual Categories master endpoints use db.categories, causing a false data-quality finding.

action_items: Fix session.too_long_16h so it normalizes/checks all attendance datetime formats and does not silently skip valid >16h rows; verify second run returns fixed=0 only after all are capped.
Change config.empty_categories to use the real categories collection (db.categories) or migrate/populate categories_master consistently, so the Data Quality report does not show false failures.
Add regression tests for timezone-aware vs naive attendance timestamps and for config detectors using the actual master-data collections.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/data_quality.py lines 763-779 catch all exceptions while parsing/checking attendance duration, which hid skipped >16h rows during testing.
backend/routes/data_quality.py line 703 checks db.categories_master, but routes/meals.py and other category flows use db.categories as the category master collection.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for focused Data Quality UI flow

seed_data_creation: Created synthetic dq_test_* users, attendance, leaves, devices, and escorts. Backend test snapshotted/restored pre-existing rows touched by bulk fixes; frontend seed was cleaned up after UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skill lookup returned no relevant testing skill. Re-run /app/tests/bug_verification_data_quality.py after fixes, then seed frontend with /app/tests/seed_dq_frontend.py for a browser check and clean with DQ_CLEANUP=1. Existing false config.empty_categories and skipped too_long rows are the blocking failures.
rca_of_the_issue: session.too_long_16h uses datetime.fromisoformat and a blanket except/continue, so rows with incompatible naive/aware datetime combinations can be skipped without being capped. config.empty_categories appears to reference a stale/nonexistent collection name (categories_master) instead of the active categories collection used by the rest of the app. Frontend cards/table, green auto-fix button with confirm/toast/refresh, and dark navigate Fix links worked in the focused browser check. Auth guard on all six fix endpoints passed: no token -> 401, member token -> 403.
